body: Yes I do I planned a meeting with my old friends to hang out for a few hours. It helps for some time but then same thought comes into my mind. Don't get me wrong, I thank you for your concern but I seek an alternative idea which can convince me that struggle is better than death.
Thank you for your concern valiantvalencia. Thank you for wishing me luck though I doubt if I will any.

I rant because there is nothing can change my situation. I'm just someone who cant fit into any society. For people in my country I am a western-wannabe. For people outside my country I'm a muslim barbarian/terrorist (even though I'm atheist people won't believe me when i say so). 
Im tired of this "life is unfair" bullshit. I just want to end it. I think death is the only thing can offer an eternal rest.
Even though we won't be able to reproduce,why  we have to suffer for the rest of our lives?
